# MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-11-06 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Definitions

- [statement] The documented connection choices are a connection string, an advanced-settings form that builds a connection string, and existing Atlas CLI configurations. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md

## How it works

- [statement] Atlas connection troubleshooting distinguishes credential problems from DNS problems: check username, password, target cluster and authSource for authentication failures; an ISP DNS server that lacks SRV lookup support can cause DNSHostNotFound. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/troubleshoot-connection/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB for VS Code supports Atlas and self-managed deployments, including standalone, replica set, and sharded cluster hosts. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration · also: https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/mongodb-for-vscode.md
- [statement] In Atlas, open the cluster Connect dialog and select MongoDB for VS Code to obtain the connection instructions; the Atlas documentation then directs users to connect with that connection string in the extension. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/mongodb-for-vscode.md
- [statement] For replica sets, the extension recommends a replica set SRV record or Replica Set Name instead of a direct member connection: a member role change can close the connection or leave stale data. Direct connections to analytics nodes are unsupported. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md
- [statement] In GitHub issue 1333, the reporter describes querySrv ECONNREFUSED with VS Code 1.132.0 and MongoDB Extension 1.16.1 on Windows while the same Atlas SRV string works in Compass. This is an attributed failure report, not a verified root cause or proof that all Atlas connections fail. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-07) — https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode/issues/1333
- [statement] The extension documents encrypted storage of connection strings and credentials through the VS Code API. Microsoft describes its SecretStorage API as encrypted, platform-dependent storage whose secrets do not sync across machines. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration · also: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api
- [statement] Disconnecting closes the active connection and requires reconnection before further data interaction. Removing a saved connection removes it from both the current workspace and VS Code globally. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The extension documents only one active deployment connection at a time; right-click a saved connection and choose Connect to activate it. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/commands.md
- [statement] If authentication is required, include database-user credentials in the connection string: the extension warns that an initial connection might succeed without them while data interaction remains unavailable. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md
- [statement] For standard Atlas connections, allow the client’s address in the project IP access list and authenticate with a database user that has access to the desired databases. An Atlas application account is separate from a database user. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/connect-to-database-deployment.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/troubleshoot-connection/
- [statement] The extension includes an Atlas Terraform template; typing atlas in a Terraform file inserts a starting configuration. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/create-cluster-terraform.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration · also: https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode
- [statement] The extension can connect to Atlas Stream Processing using a Stream Processing Workspace connection string. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration · also: https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode
- [statement] The documented advanced connection form does not support CSFLE In-Use Encryption or Kerberos Authentication. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md
- [statement] The extension includes an Atlas Terraform template for creating a cluster; this is an extension feature, with provider configuration outside this concept’s scope. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/connect.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code connections and Atlas integration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/create-cluster-terraform.md
